page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn9gc.4xlarge is a GPU-accelerated virtual instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 16 dedicated x86_64 vCPUs driven by an AMD EPYC 9A75 processor running at a base clock speed of 3.3 GHz. The instance is provisioned with 128.0 GB of system memory, resulting in an allocation ratio of 8.0 GB of RAM per vCPU.

Hardware acceleration is provided by an onboard NVIDIA Blackwell GPU offering 72 GB of VRAM. The instance does not feature integrated local storage, requiring network-attached storage volumes for operating system disks and persistent file storage. Networking capabilities include a baseline network bandwidth of 16 Gbps, while zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses are included by default.

The server architecture balances compute cores with substantial GPU acceleration and memory density. Because local disk storage is absent, data throughput relies on the network interface and attached storage volumes. This hardware configuration is suited for AI model inference, targeted deep learning fine-tuning, computer vision pipelines, and high-performance scientific simulations.
